items.reason: Gap 0 describes two deliveries of the same event running concurrently, both passing the Set check before either adds the id, so the event is processed twice.
Gap 1 says deduplication keys on the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that changing or forging it on a signed body bypasses or poisons deduplication.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are never recorded.
No gap depends on several processes or replicas; the concurrency raised is among queue workers in one process.
